title: Runescape: Dragonwilds : Ep12 The Battle with Velgar!
author: Hiccup The Hermit
chapters: Back to the Wise Old Man
description:
***Become a Hermitage Hero (a channel member) and get access to cool perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCr93a6tGgqTknMMiABCc0sg/join

*The Battle With Velgar! - (10:44)

Hey hey everyone! Thanks for joining me on my adventures into Runescape Dragonwilds!
I'm really excited to dive into this world! I know nothing more than what I saw in the trailer, which is exactly how I prefer to game. So come along as we figure out how to survive in this wonderful and magical new world! Wish me luck, lets gooo!!!


Going to fight that Dragon! - (0:00)
The Battle With Velgar! - (10:44)
Back to the Wise Old Man - (15:02)
Dagger and Shield - (26:18)
Wrap UP - (35:03)


If you enjoyed this episode and would like to see more of this playthrough, be sure to check out the Playlist here! -
** https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLr4PvxKRV2AsQ9cDAOePoIN5dE1206E0p **

If you enjoyed hanging out with me here at the Digital Hermitage feel free to check out these other games we play here! VALHEIM is the most prominent game on my channel and Im currently running a valheim playthrough alongside this Runescape Dragonwilds playthrough. Follow along on my adventures through a viking afterlife! Valheim is another wonderful Survival crafting adventure game, check it out! Here's the link to my Season 4 Valheim playthrough! Hope to see you there. -
** https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLr4PvxKRV2AsEqoXvTuK6LMl4tqAtLXJs **
